description: This file contains functions for converting OpenAPI v3 schemas into internal structural schema representations within the Kubernetes API extensions server, including validation and handling of schema fields.

classes.name: Structural
classes.description: Represents a structural schema derived from an OpenAPI v3 schema.

classes.name: StructuralOrBool
classes.description: Wrapper for either a Structural schema or a boolean value.

classes.name: Generic
classes.description: Holds generic schema metadata such as type, description, title, default, and nullability.

classes.name: ValueValidation
classes.description: Contains validation constraints like maximum, pattern, enum, and composite schemas (allOf, anyOf, oneOf).

classes.name: NestedValueValidation
classes.description: Nested schema validation with properties, items, and additional properties.

classes.name: ValidationExtensions
classes.description: Contains additional validation rules, including Kubernetes-specific validation.

methods.name: NewStructural
methods.description: Converts an OpenAPI v3 JSONSchemaProps into a Structural schema, validating unsupported fields and processing nested schemas.

methods.name: newGenerics
methods.description: Creates a Generic object from JSONSchemaProps metadata.

methods.name: newValueValidation
methods.description: Creates a ValueValidation object from JSONSchemaProps, including enum and composite schemas.

methods.name: newNestedValueValidation
methods.description: Creates a NestedValueValidation object for nested schemas, handling properties, items, and additional properties.

methods.name: newValidationExtensions
methods.description: Converts validation rules to internal ValidationExtensions.

methods.name: validateUnsupportedFields
methods.description: Checks that unsupported schema fields are unset, returning an error if any are set.
